packages.name: dynamodb-guard
packages.summary: Catches DynamoDB expressions that DynamoDB would reject, such as a reserved word like status used without an alias, before you deploy. Runs as an ESLint rule, a unit-test helper or a CDK synth check.

packages.name: composurecdk-stream-dlq
packages.summary: Saves a Lambda stream consumer's failed batches to S3 before the stream's retention window drops them, and alarms when one arrives. Manual replay is still to come.
